claims.quote: Given that we now have AI and other methods of genealogy, we can make a connection between graves and ancestors.
claims.supporting_quote: With the help of my friend, Phillip Collins, who has used genealogy, WikiTree and AI, we have managed to trace a whole range of my forebears there.
claims.claim: AI, alongside other genealogy methods, can help trace ancestors and link them to their graves.
claims.vintage_rationale: AI-assisted genealogy tools are available; the claim is modest and remains true.

coder_notes: Borderline inclusion: a modest "we can" claim backed by a friend’s use of AI for genealogy. Could reasonably be treated as anecdote with nothing to check. capability_since not estimable.

claims.quote: Within the last few months, it has become straightforward for anyone with access to a coding agent and a good idea to produce software that makes that idea happen with a minimum of effort and expertise and certainly much quicker than ever was the case before.
claims.supporting_quote: Although I am not a trained software engineer, I have produced 10 applications in the last year that now work to do things.
claims.claim: Coding agents now let non-experts build working software quickly with little effort or expertise.
claims.vintage_rationale: Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex and similar) made app-building by non-programmers routine by 2025-26.

near_misses.quote: The House rightly has concerns about the threats posed by AI, but we have to ensure that we structure the fundamentals of our public services in ways that British firms and the public can use to realise the benefits of AI.

coder_notes: Speaker says "coding agent" without the word AI in that sentence; included because a coding agent is an AI system by definition and he links it to realising "the benefits of AI". capability_since 2025-02 (Claude Code research preview) is coder_recall; the speaker dates it to "the last few months", which may understate its age.

claims.quote: Their wealth has been built on public research and public investment, as well as all our shared written inheritance, which has trained the models they use.
claims.claim: AI models were trained on the shared body of human writing, built on public research and investment.
claims.vintage_rationale: Large language models are trained on large corpora of published text; this remains an accepted description.

claims.claim: US AI and big tech corporations will soon be among the wealthiest and most powerful private actors in history.
claims.vintage_rationale: Statement about the near future; arguably already partly true given record market capitalisations.
